text:
Maria Chen: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Done: finalized hero and subhead for the benchmark post, uploaded art assets to Figma, added alt text. Draft is at figma.com/file/xyz.
Blocker: embed iframe sizes still ambiguous (desktop vs mobile breakpoints). Need final px from eng so responsive mock is accurate.
Today: iterate on two CTA variants for A/B, request final bench numbers for the embed snippet, and queue copy for legal review. Alex, can you glance at CTAs later?

Alex Rivera: got it, will review CTAs after lunch. For embed dims — can we standardize to 700px max width, 100% on mobile? If engineering calls for specific breakpoints we can update. Also: how critical is the iframe vs inline svg?

Maria Chen: iframe preferred for analytics, but if eng says performance hit we can fallback to inline. Need numbers to decide.

Sam Patel: quick embed bench update from bench-bot: average render+embed call is ~12ms on p95 in our staging with text-embedding-3-small (512d). Cost estimate ~ $0.00018 per embed in current batch config. Re-running with batch=32 to compare.

bench-bot: latest bench run (ping @Sam Patel) — config: model=text-embedding-3-small, batch=16, concurrency=8. Results: mean=9.8ms, p95=12.6ms, cost_per_embed=$0.00018. Full CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/1901234567-results.csv :thumbsup:

Alex Rivera: that p95 looks fine. Maria — if batch=32 drops cost, are we okay with slightly higher latency for non-interactive use? For blog embeds we can pre-compute and cache.

Maria Chen: yes caching is fine for the blog. For the interactive demo on landing page, we need realtime <100ms. We should pin interactive to a smaller model or use cached predictions.

Jen O'Neil: publishing schedule update — editorial moved the slot to Thursday 10:00am PT to line up with partner newsletter. If we want the interactive demo live, engineering needs final signoff by Wednesday EOD.

Sam Patel: re-run complete — batch=32 results: mean=7.2ms, p95=9.1ms, cost_per_embed=$0.00012. CSV: s3://redwood-bench/1901234567-batch32.csv. If we precompute for blog and cache for demo, costs look good.

Maria Chen: excellent — that lets us keep the nicer CTA copy on the hero. Alex — can you confirm CTAs by EOD? Jen — noting the Wed EOD signoff. I'll ping legal after Alex thumbs up.

Alex Rivera: will do, pinging now. Also leaving a small nit: change button label from "Try it" to "Try the demo" for clarity.

Maria Chen: noted, updating Figma. Thanks all. :party_parrot: 

Jen O'Neil: marking calendar. If anything blocks, call out ASAP in this thread.

Sam Patel: leaving final note — if anyone wants raw bench graphs I pushed to the #eng-ml channel and in the S3 path above.

Maria Chen: thanks — closing the loop. :thumbsup:
